THE NEST IS BUILT AND MEASURED GREEN. Ruling 2026-08-06-a-stack-of-sieves-is-a-nest (Akien-confirmed) is conformed by both its artifacts: `bin/cmd/ruling verify` returns {green:true, failures:[]}. build_inspector's 18 sieves are now shaken ONCE, coarsest band first, emitting a GRADATION (score per sieve per component) rather than pass/fail. A sieve's BAND IS DERIVED from what its own body reaches (import_sieve.reach_of over inspector.py's source) — never authored; a tooth mutates charter_on_disk to import db_domain and asserts it drops to band 3. Measured derivation: in-hand 3, local-disk 2, correlated-local 13, off-box 0. Roll-up is min(), never mean(). A sieve stopped by a coarser band is ABSENT from the report, never 0.0 — no tri-value.

THE CONSUMER PASS IS DONE (Akien: 'we have to sort the consumer for every single one of them except the diagnostic inspector'). Six of seven emitters already had an answer, scattered across four homes; I lifted them into `for_whom`, the field five charters already carried. build_inspector -> base/transitions.py (the emit chokepoint refuses the crossing) + Akien for disposition. intention_extractor -> 'CC today, the librarian later' (was in extractor.py:26). learning_block -> Akien is the gate, skills are the callers. Both probes -> their tickets' watchme.consumer, reached by an owning_ticket() POINTER not a copy. diagnostic_inspector -> CC during debugging, EXEMPT by Akien's ruling, now recorded with its provenance.

DIAGNOSTIC_INSPECTOR GREW A CHECK. Akien specified what the report owes me as its consumer: where it failed, what the failure was, what variables were in play, what it was operating on, millisecond-to-millisecond run-up. Measuring that against SEED found a translation loss: I-complete-diagnostic-on-first-pass names `source` and 'every value at every transition and boundary that bears on the fault', and SEED had dropped both while claiming to carry the list outright. `source` rejoined SEED (reads green — the seed's job is to MATCH THE INTENTION, not to be interestingly unmet). The every-value clause became `values_at_the_fault`, a per-gate count of records that witnessed a crossing and said nothing about what it held — a CHECK not a key, because requiring the literal key 'values' is missing-by-construction (_completeness scans INTO values and excludes the wrapper). Deliberately NOT folded into `complete`: that answers 'did a LEARNED gap recur' (terminal falsifier); this answers 'was there anything to learn from at all'. 13/13 teeth green, three mutations verified red at their own tooth.

CORPUS: 88 proofs, 87 green, 1 red — unchanged baseline. The red is pre-existing: CairnCommons/node_classes/skill.json `members_so_far` omits /design and /idea. Both repos clean and pushed (cairn 35736b4, commons dea53b8).
